task_meta.title: Write a safe, re-runnable SQLite migration that splits full_name

claim_text:
I've written the migration in `migrations/002_split_full_name.sql`. `python run_tests.py` passes (2/2), and running it two or three times in a row leaves the data and schema exactly as the first run did.

**Why it rebuilds the table:** SQLite has no `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, so
digest: Read 1 file (1 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 4 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
